g.text: DataPoisoning Detector v1 Large / Internal benchmark
Teal: our CAT evaluation Purple: LightShed published Table 2
Our results: 200 protected images per method; one shared pool of 200 clean images. Five crops; fixed thresholds.
LightShed: independently published evaluation, not run on this internal test. Glaze version/settings may differ.
Not reported = absent from Table 2, not zero performance. Source: USENIX Security 2025, Foerster et al., Table 2.
